datasets.name: d8df1bb3
queryLines:
select distinct(item_name), SUM(quantity) as total_quantity_sold
from ws_restaurantanalyticsplatform_7405614613479137.`02_silver`.fact_order_items
where order_date between :Date_Range.min and :Date_Range.max and item_name != 'Gajar Halwa'
group by item_name, order_date
order by total_quantity_sold desc
limit 10

datasets.name: 9e907cac
datasets.displayName: Restaurant Daily Review Sentiment Summary Dataset
queryLines:
SELECT
    r.name AS restaurant_name,
    date(review_timestamp) AS review_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sentiment = 'positive' THEN order_id ELSE NULL END) AS positive_review_ct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN order_id ELSE NULL END) AS negative_review_ct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sentiment = 'neutral' THEN order_id ELSE NULL END) AS neutral_review_ct
FROM ws_restaurantanalyticsplatform_7405614613479137.`02_silver`.fact_reviews fr
JOIN ws_restaurantanalyticsplatform_7405614613479137.`02_silver`.dim_restaurants r
    ON fr.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

datasets.name: 16e94a1f
queryLines:
select rest.name as restaurant_name,
count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN review.issue_delivery = 'true' THEN review.restaurant_id ELSE NULL END) as delivary_issue_count,
count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN review.issue_food_quality = 'true' THEN review.restaurant_id ELSE NULL END) as food_quality_issue_count,
count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN review.issue_pricing = 'true' THEN review.restaurant_id ELSE NULL END) as pricing_issue_count,
count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN review.issue_portion_size = 'true' THEN review.restaurant_id ELSE NULL END) as portion_size_issue_count
from ws_restaurantanalyticsplatform_7405614613479137.`02_silver`.fact_reviews review
join ws_restaurantanalyticsplatform_7405614613479137.`02_silver`.dim_restaurants rest 
on review.restaurant_id = rest.restaurant_id
group by rest.name

datasets.name: fd616c5e
queryLines:
select rest.name as restaurant_name,
review.review_text as review,
review.review_timestamp
from ws_restaurantanalyticsplatform_7405614613479137.`02_silver`.fact_reviews review
join ws_restaurantanalyticsplatform_7405614613479137.`02_silver`.dim_restaurants rest 
on review.restaurant_id = rest.restaurant_id
where review.sentiment = 'positive' and review.review_text is not null
order by review.review_timestamp desc
